source.description: An embedded-graphics backend for Ratatui with an adjustable font size

evidence.observation: full_name iddey/dumo, archived false, default branch main, last pushed 2026-03-31. Repository description: "An embedded-graphics backend for Ratatui with an adjustable font size".

Package dumo 0.1.1 depends on ratatui-core 0.1.0, embedded-graphics 0.8.2 and mplusfonts 0.3.4, with ratatui 0.30 as a dev-dependency. The `font-kanji` feature "Adds 5 553 Unicode code points, the kanji characters", and the `alt-jis2004` feature renders kanji with JIS X 0213:2004 glyphs.

README describes dumo as an "embedded-graphics backend for ratatui v0.30.0 'Bryndza' built on the ratatui-core crate" and says it contains preconfigured mplusfonts bitmap fonts. It shows Ratatui Tabs, List and Calendar widgets running on small displays and e-paper.

limitations: Did not build or run the crate or its examples (esp32s3, rp2350a).
assessment.reason: Verified that iddey/dumo is the canonical repository and is not archived. It is an embedded-graphics backend for Ratatui 0.30, built on ratatui-core, and it depends on mplusfonts. Kanji support exists through the `font-kanji` feature, which adds 5,553 code points. Every claim in the current description checks out. The upstream tagline now stresses "adjustable font size", but the existing wording is still accurate.

source.description: A ratatui backend that is also an egui widget. Deploy on web with WASM or ship natively with bevy, macroquad, or eframe

evidence.observation: full_name gold-silver-copper/egui_ratatui, archived false, default_branch update, last pushed 2026-04-16. Description: "A ratatui backend that is also an egui widget. Deploy on web with WASM or ship natively with bevy, macroquad, or eframe".

egui_ratatui 2.2.0 depends on ratatui-core 0.1, egui ~0.34 and soft_ratatui ~0.2, with crate-type cdylib/rlib. The workspace members are ".", bevy_example and eframe_example, and the workspace dependency is ratatui 0.30.

README says `RataguiBackend` is a combined ratatui Backend and egui Widget, describes it as "WASM compatible: run your ratatui apps in the browser via egui", and links Bevy, Macroquad and eframe WASM guides.
The bevy example depends on bevy (git), bevy_egui, ratatui, egui_ratatui and soft_ratatui. The eframe example depends on eframe 0.34 and egui_ratatui.

limitations: The repository has no dedicated macroquad example. Macroquad support rests on the README's Macroquad WASM guide link and the official repo description, not on a tested example.
Did not build or run the examples.
assessment.reason: Verified that gold-silver-copper/egui_ratatui is canonical (default branch `update`) and is not archived. The crate `RataguiBackend` is both a ratatui Backend and an egui Widget, and it uses ratatui-core and soft_ratatui. WASM/web deployment is documented. The workspace contains bevy and eframe examples. The README links a Macroquad WASM guide, and the official repo description still names macroquad. The description matches the upstream repo description almost word for word.

evidence.observation: full_name ratatui/mousefood, archived false, default_branch main, last pushed 2026-11-09. Description: "Build embedded applications with Ratatui! 🧀".
Workspace members are mousefood, mousefood-extras and examples/*. Workspace dependencies include ratatui-core 0.1.2, ratatui 0.30.2 and embedded-graphics 0.8.2.
Package mousefood 0.5.3 has description "embedded-graphics backend for Ratatui" and depends on ratatui-core and embedded-graphics. It has optional EPD features (weact, waveshare, lilygo-epd47).
README: "Mousefood - a no-std embedded-graphics backend for Ratatui!" It includes a quickstart that uses EmbeddedBackend with a ratatui Terminal.

limitations: Did not build or run the crate or its hardware examples.
assessment.reason: Verified that ratatui/mousefood is the canonical repository, owned by the Ratatui org, not archived, and was pushed to on 2026-11-09. The workspace member `mousefood` (0.5.3) is described as an "embedded-graphics backend for Ratatui" and depends on ratatui-core and embedded-graphics. The README calls it a no-std embedded-graphics backend for Ratatui. The current description is accurate.
